The “Lose weight and burn fat” Meditation draws on Agesta’s sacred codes to initiate transformative shifts in your life. For optimal results, practice this meditation daily for 9, 15, or 21 consecutive days.

For accelerated benefits, it is strongly advised to complete the “Inner Cleanse” meditation sessions beforehand.

Sacred codes are sequences of numbers believed to help you connect with higher energies, bring your intentions to life, and foster healing. Channellers like Jose Gabriel Uribe (Agesta) introduced these codes, which come from beings of light and serve as a tool to raise human consciousness.

When using a sacred code, repeat the numerical sequence either silently or out loud, ideally in a calm, meditative state. Combining the elements of numerology, meditation, and energy healing, these codes have been credited with positive effects by many practitioners. They remain a compelling resource in contemporary esoteric practices.

Meditation’s Benefits and Sacred Codes:

  • Invoke Archangel Raphael and His Healing Energy (Code: 29)
  • Increase your self-confidence (Code: 4 51)
  • Gain self-control and discipline (Code: 8 97)
  • Eliminate your self-sabotage (Code: 5 93)
  • Achieve balance (Code: 2 12)
  • Change your eating habits (Code: 1 52)

  • Strengthen your muscles (Code: 27 10)
  • Speed up your metabolism (Code: 2 11)
  • Lose your weight (Code: 32 19 4)
  • Eliminate your obesity (Code: 9 89)
  • Reduce your stomach size to eat less (Code: 39)
  • Regulate your cortisol hormone (Code: 54)
  • Live in the present moment (Code: 7 89)
  • Regulate your water retention (Code: 10 0 4)
  • Flow in your life (Code: 10 9)
  • Eliminate your stress (Code: 52 57 9)
  • Eliminate your anxiety (Code: 3 63)
  • Achieve conscious breathing (Code: 25 0 0)
  • Decrease your excessive appetite (Code: 5 51)
  • Banish excess of your body fat (Code: 76)
  • Lose excess of your abdominal fat (Code: 7 20)
  • Eliminate your double chin (Code: 76)
  • Invoke the energy of the Body elemental (Code: 97)
  • Increase your self-love and self-esteem (Code: 8 77)
  • Remove the dissatisfaction with your body (Code: 5 0 5)
  • Activate your physical and sexual attractiveness (Code: 9 0 4)
  • Achieve your success in life (Code: 21 90)
  • Embrace gratitude in all aspects of your life (Code: 33 33)
